units.source_text: 鬼卒马上乘风飞到地狱的天上，一瞬间就牵着两头牲畜，闪电般落在阎罗殿前。

en.t: The demon guard at once rode the wind up into the sky over hell, and in an instant led down two beasts, landing like lightning before King Yama's hall.

units.source_text: 看到那两头牲畜，杜子春吓得难以置信，

en.t: When Tu Zichun saw those two beasts, he was frightened beyond belief,

units.source_text: 因为那虽然只是两批瘦的可怜的马，

en.t: because although they were only two pitifully thin horses,

units.source_text: 但它们的脸确实杜子春做梦也忘不掉的已经故去的父母的样子。

en.t: but their faces were unmistakably those of his dead parents, whom Tu Zichun could not forget even in his dreams.
